item.title: Our Haus, Our Humanity: Lessons from the Queer Community That Can Help Heal Medicine
item.description: Dominic Moog, BA Since the COVID-19 pandemic and 2020 protests against systemic racism, efforts toward eradicating the effects of bias and discrimination in medicine has reentered the national consciousness. While this is a good start, it may be better to try to overhaul -- or at least make deeper efforts to heal-- medicine’s social environment to foster safety and reduce disparately harmful effects of chronic social stress.
